[P2] Apply breaking-change release treatment to the additional data loss

For the same record and limit, this intentionally removes results and whole operations that the previous version retained, changing existing telemetry queries and assertions after an upgrade. This meets `CHANGELOG.md`'s definition of a breaking change despite the unchanged signature. `CONTRIBUTING.md` rule 1.3 requires breaking-change release treatment, and root `AGENTS.md` requires an `[Unreleased]` entry, which this diff lacks. Return to the design/release decision and document the affected truncation cases in the changelog.
